criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: General Information Query
categories.definition: User asks for factual information, definitions, how-to instructions, or general knowledge not specific to their personal accounts or current context.

categories.name: Personal Information Query
categories.definition: User asks for information specific to their personal accounts, status, history, or current context.

categories.name: Assistant Identity Query
categories.definition: User asks questions about the assistant's nature, origin, or capabilities.

categories.name: Device/Assistant Setting Control
categories.definition: User requests changes to the assistant's behavior, voice, or device settings.

categories.name: Scheduling & Reminders
categories.definition: User requests to set, check, modify, or cancel appointments, reminders, or calendar events.

categories.name: Financial Account Management
categories.definition: User requests actions related to their financial accounts, cards, or insurance.

categories.name: Navigation & Location
categories.definition: User requests directions, location information, or to find places.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: User requests to send messages or make calls.

categories.name: Shopping & Purchasing
categories.definition: User requests to buy items or add them to a shopping list with the intent of purchase.

categories.name: Search & Discovery
categories.definition: User requests to find specific content, products, services, or information that requires searching a database or the web, without immediate purchase intent.

categories.name: Travel Planning
categories.definition: User requests to plan or inquire about specific travel arrangements, flights, or destinations for their trip.

categories.name: Calculations
categories.definition: User requests mathematical computations or unit conversions.

categories.name: Direct Action/Physical Control
categories.definition: User requests the assistant to perform a physical action or control an external device.

categories.name: Conversational/Confirmation
categories.definition: User engages in general conversation, provides feedback, or confirms information.

categories.name: User Identity/Naming
categories.definition: User asks what the assistant calls them or requests a specific name for themselves.
